verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a knowledge-management app, but the evidence pack documents no rule or trigger engine in Anytype. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: auto-updating Queries, Templates applied to new Objects, a local API and headless CLI for scripting, and an agents skill that runs scripts. None of these is a user-defined event-to-action rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
